title: How does a rain cloud become a typhoon?
question: Does a rain cloud grow over a cold sea too?
steps: Drag the cloud with your finger and put it over the sea.
Watch the cloud take up water vapor and grow, or lose its strength.
Use the button at the bottom left to make the sea cold, warm or very warm.
observe: Over a warm sea, water vapor rises and the cloud grows into a rain cloud. Over a very warm sea it grows even bigger and becomes a spinning typhoon. Over a cold sea or over land there is no vapor to feed it, so the cloud loses its strength.

terms.name: Water vapor
terms.description: Water warmed into an invisible gas. The warmer the sea, the more of it rises.

terms.name: Rain cloud
terms.description: A dark cloud that has taken up lots of water vapor and grown big enough to rain.

terms.name: Typhoon
terms.description: A rain cloud that grew very big over a very warm sea and spins round and round. It brings strong winds and lots of rain.

law.equation: warm sea + water vapor = a growing rain cloud
law.title: The sea's warmth and rain clouds
law.description: Over a warm sea lots of water vapor rises, and a rain cloud feeds on it and grows. Over a very warm sea it grows very big and becomes a typhoon. When a typhoon moves over a cold sea or land, there is no vapor to feed it, so it gets weaker.

tip: Drag the cloud with one finger and put it anywhere over the sea. Depending on the sea under it, the cloud grows or loses its strength. The far sea at the top is always cold.
tip_short: Drag the cloud over the sea

predict.question: Does a rain cloud grow over a cold sea too?
predict.reason: Little water vapor rises from a cold sea. So the rain cloud has nothing to feed on and hardly grows.
predict.bridge: Move the cloud and see for yourself!

stages.text: Put the little cloud over the warm sea and grow it into a rain cloud!
stages.say: Over a warm sea, water vapor keeps rising. The cloud takes it up and grows bigger and bigger.
stages.miss: Leave it over the sea longer!

stages.text: See if a rain cloud becomes a typhoon over a very warm sea!
stages.say: When the sea is very warm, lots and lots of water vapor rises. The rain cloud grows, starts to spin and becomes a typhoon.
stages.win: So that's how a typhoon is born!
stages.miss: Leave it over the sea longer!

stages.text: Drag the typhoon heading for the island to the cold sea to weaken it!
stages.say: A typhoon feeds on the water vapor of a warm sea. Over a cold sea there is nothing to feed on, so it gets weaker and weaker.
stages.win: The sea is calm! The piece!

kid.intro: This is the typhoon lab. Lots of water vapor rises from a warm sea. Rain clouds feed on this vapor and grow bigger and bigger.

intro_more.text: A rain cloud that grows very big and spins round and round is called a **typhoon**. Let's first find out with a little cloud how a typhoon grows and how it gets weaker.

kid.title: Move the cloud over the sea and grow it!

note.law: A rain cloud grows on the water vapor of a warm sea. Over a very warm sea it becomes a typhoon; over a cold sea or land it weakens.
note.learn: Rain clouds grow on the water vapour of a warm sea. Over a very warm sea they become a typhoon; over a cool sea or land they lose their strength.
